name: WWWF World Championship
epitaph: Crowned in a single-night, best-of-three-falls tournament at the fed's own inaugural WrestlePania, 27 March 1997, with Stone Cold Steve Austin winning an Iron Man final over Mr. Perfect.
notes: First held by Stone Cold Steve Austin, now minted as a real-wrestler portrayal.

name: WWWF World Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Crowned the same night as the World Championship, at WrestlePania (27 March 1997): the Head Hunters won a six-team, best-of-three-falls tournament final over Randy Savage and Sting in a specially-ruled Death Match (three straight pinfalls).
notes: First held by the Head Hunters, now minted as real-wrestler portrayals.

name: WWWF United States Championship
epitaph: Crowned three days after WrestlePania, at Saturday ShootOut (30 March 1997): Head Hunter #1 won a 16-man over-the-top battle royal, becoming the fed's first multi-belt holder.
notes: First held by Head Hunter #1, now minted as a real-wrestler portrayal.
